title: 第17章 万澜传人
content_zh:
过了好一会，岳青问：“少堡主，你能下来么？”温文新用力挣扎，挣不脱脚上的绑缚，大是羞惭，明明是不能下来，这句话却又怎能出口？只胀红了脸不作声。岳青说：“你别动，小心摔下来。我上来助你。”纵身跃高，想要拉住树干攀上，但那树干甚高，这一跃没能抓住，当下手足并用，爬上树干。

    爬到树干中间，忽听马蹄声响，一行人自北而来。此时晨光熹微，天将黎明，岳青心想：“怎么这么早就有人赶路？”转瞬间，一行人已来到树下，共是人马九乘。那九人见一个大姑娘爬在高树上，都感诧异，勒马观看。岳青嗔说：“有什么好瞧的？走你们的路吧！”那九人也不理睬，再看到树顶绑着一个青年男子，更是奇怪。

    岳青未到树顶，提气上跃，左手已在半空中抓住一根树枝，一拉之下，借势翻上，蹿到了温文新身旁。树底下两人齐声喝彩：“好俊的轻功！”岳青将温文新手脚上的布条解开，低声问：“没受伤么？”她这句柔声相询，温文新听了大慰，说道：“没什么。”拉住树枝一荡，从数丈高处轻轻跃下。岳青跟着下来，见马上九人指指点点，肆无忌惮的好生无礼，不禁心下恼怒，向他们横了一眼。

    只见九人有老有少，衣饰都颇华贵，个个腰挺背直，豪健彪悍。居中簇拥着一位四十来岁的中年富绅，那富绅面目清秀，丰神俊朗，容止都雅，身穿一件宝蓝色风衣，头戴八角帽，帽子正中缝着一块寸许见方的芙玉。岳青从小就在物流公司，很识得珠宝，这时相隔数丈，仍可看到那块美玉莹然生光，知道是价值连城的宝物，他这么随随便便缝在帽上，也不怕失落，心中好奇，不由向他多望了一眼。

    那富绅见她明艳照人，身材婀娜，心中一动，向身旁一个中年人低声说了几句。那人点点头，突然纵声大笑，高声说：“你这小贼定是偷人家东西，给高高吊在树上了吧。”一个老者笑问：“你说偷了什么？怎么他妹子又这么巴巴地来救他？”他语带轻薄，神色浮滑。

    温文新本已满腔怒火难以发泄，听了这些言语，突然纵身上去，啪的一声，打了这老者一个耳光。老者骑在马上，和他相隔丈余，他一跃之间就打到人家耳光，倒也大出诸人意料之外。众人不自禁勒马退后，愕然相顾。老者不提防受辱，如何忍得下这口气？立即闪身下马，伸手来抓他衣襟。温文新反手一勾，拿他手腕。老者也是身有武功，以抓变掌，掌底穿拳。二人在大路旁斗了起来。

    温文新虽让闵嘉庚打了一顿，也没伤到筋骨，一来意中人在旁观斗，二来屈气难伸，将八卦掌施展出来，越来越狠。老者一招接不住，肩头连中两掌，踉踉跄跄退开几步。他一定神待要再上，马上一人叫道：“何老你退下，这小子有点邪门。”

    话声甫毕，一个人影轻飘飘从马背上跃了下来。老者当即闪开。温文新和岳青见此人身手了得，不禁都留上了神。但见他一张紫膛脸，神态威猛，身材魁梧，站着比温文新要高出大半个头。他双手负在背后，向温文新打量，问道：“你是万澜传人吗？你师父姓温还是姓汪？”一副傲慢的神色，全没把对方放在眼里。

    温文新大怒，喝道：“你管得着么？”那人微微一笑说：“天下只要是万澜传人，我们就管得着。”温文新为人本来精细，但此番连受挫折，盛怒之下，没细想他言语中的含意，一招“劈雷坠地”往他膝盖上击去，出手甚是迅疾。

    那人微微一笑，右手轻挥，向左踏了一步，顿时将他这一击化解了。温文新游身八卦掌一经施出，再不停留，脚下每一步都按着先天八卦的图式，转折如意，四梢归一，绕着对方身子急速奔跑，一掌掌越打越快。那大汉双手出招极短，只比着招式，始终不与温文新手掌相触，但他所出的每一招却无一不是温文新掌法的克星，往往令他招式未曾使足，便迫得收掌变势。霎时间，温文新打出了四十余掌，竟没一掌带到他一点衣角。与那大汉同来的人看得心旷神怡，不住口喝彩。

    温文新焦躁起来，奔跑更速，掌法催紧。那大汉仍然好整以暇，面露微笑，双掌或挥或按，便如是独自练拳一般。此时温文新已然瞧出，对方出招虽然极短，脚下却也按着先天八卦图式，方位丝毫不乱。他曾听母亲说过，八卦掌中有一项极精深的内八卦功夫，只有将外八卦功夫练至登峰造极后方能起始学练，但只要一练成，那时以静制动，克敌机先，差不多就无敌于天下了。眼前此人明明让着自己，只要他当真一出手，一招间就能将自己打倒。他越想越惶恐，纵步后跃，躬身抱拳说：“晚辈有眼不识泰山，原来是本门前辈到了！”说着深深打躬。

    那人微微一笑，仍然问：“你师父姓温还是姓汪？”温文新曾得母亲嘱咐，在人前千万不可吐露身份，以防对头知悉，挫折了报仇大事，不禁踌躇不答。那人笑着说：“你掌法门户开阔，瞧来是宏伟师哥一派了。大哥，你说是不是？”最后一句话是向马上另一个壮汉而说。那壮汉年近五十，翻身下马，向温文新说：“你师父呢？引我们去见见。我是你厉师叔，这位是我兄弟，你拜师叔吧。”说着哈哈大笑。

    温文新知道父亲温宏伟的师父是万澜集团老总厉士玉。厉总精通八卦掌、八卦刀，后来又自创威风激穿拳、荣光之爪、霸体钢腕，当年威风八面，号称“马踏黄河两岸，拳打南北五路。”眼前这人姓厉，又是八卦掌的高手，定然不假了。但他生性精细，加问一句：“两位跟万澜厉总是怎生称呼？”那二人相顾一笑，那壮汉说：“那是咱哥俩的先父。你还不信么？温师哥呢？”

    温文新更无迟疑，扑翻在地，磕了几个头，口称师叔，说道：“先父早已去世，师叔当年没接到讣告么？”

    那年长的名叫厉宏生，他兄弟名叫厉宏明，都是厉士玉的儿子。厉士玉当年在协力社手里受挫后，回家收了万澜物流集团，从此闭门谢客，次年便去世了。温宏伟是他的开山大弟子，但师徒间情谊平常，学成后早早就离开申城，并没有在万澜集团任职。万澜集团收手后，厉氏兄弟进入仕途，青云得意，从来就没将这个身在葶野的师哥放在心上。因此双方虽相隔不远，温宏伟逝世的讯息厉氏兄弟竟然不知。

    厉宏生叹了口气，回身向那富绅低声说了几句话。那富绅眼角向岳青斜睨一眼，欢然点头。厉宏生对温文新说：“你家住此不远吧？你带我兄弟到你父亲灵前一拜。我们师兄弟一别二十余年，想不到从此不能再见。”他顿了一顿，伸手向那富绅一张，介绍：“你来拜见吴总，我们都在吴总手下办事。”

    温文新见那富绅气度高华，想是**的达官贵人，这才收得厉氏兄弟这等高手为他办事，当即上前躬身下拜。吴总只摆摆手，说声：“请起！”却不回礼。温文新微微有气，心想：“好大的架子！”
content_en:
After a while, Yue Qing asked: "Young Lord, can you come down?" Wen Wenxin struggled hard and couldn't break free from the bindings on his feet. He was so embarrassed. He obviously couldn't come down, but how could he say these words?He just blushed and remained silent.Yue Qing said: "Don't move, be careful of falling. I'll come up to help you." He jumped high and tried to grab the tree trunk to climb up, but the tree trunk was very high and he couldn't catch it with this leap. He immediately used his hands and feet to climb up the tree trunk.
Climbing to the middle of the tree trunk, I suddenly heard the sound of horse hooves, and a group of people came from the north.At this time, the morning light was fading, and it was about to dawn. Yue Qing thought to himself: "Why are there people on their way so early?" In an instant, the group of people had arrived under the tree, and there were nine people and horses in total.The nine people were surprised to see a big girl climbing on a tall tree, and reined in their horses to watch.Yue Qing said angrily, "What's there to see? Just go your way!" The nine people ignored them, and they were even more surprised to see a young man tied to the top of the tree.
Before Yue Qing reached the top of the tree, he raised his energy and jumped up. He grabbed a branch in mid-air with his left hand, pulled it, used the momentum to flip up, and jumped to Wen Wenxin's side.The two people under the tree cheered in unison: "What a handsome Qinggong!" Yue Qing untied the cloth strips on Wen Wenxin's feet and asked in a low voice: "Are you not injured?" She asked softly, Wen Wenxin was greatly relieved after hearing this, and said: "Nothing." He pulled the branch and swung, and jumped down from a height of several feet.Yue Qing followed him down and saw the nine people on the horse pointing and being unscrupulous and rude. He couldn't help but feel angry and glanced at them.
I saw nine people, old and young, all dressed in luxurious clothes. All of them had straight backs and were strong and strong.In the center was a middle-aged wealthy gentleman in his forties. The wealthy gentleman had a delicate face, a handsome face, and an elegant appearance. He was wearing a sapphire blue windbreaker and an octagonal hat, with a square piece of fuyu sewn in the middle of the hat.Yue Qing had been working in a logistics company since he was a child and was very familiar with jewelry. At this moment, a few feet away, he could still see the beautiful jade shining brightly. He knew it was a priceless treasure. He sewed it on the hat so casually, not afraid of losing it. He was curious and couldn't help but look at him one more time.
When the rich gentleman saw her beauty and graceful figure, his heart moved and he whispered a few words to a middle-aged man next to him.The man nodded, suddenly laughed loudly, and said loudly: "You little thief must have stolen someone's things and hung them high in a tree." An old man asked with a smile: "What did you say you stole? Why is his sister so eager to save him?" He said with a frivolous tone and a slippery look.
Wen Wenxin was filled with anger and could not vent his anger. After hearing these words, he suddenly jumped up and slapped the old man in the face.The old man was riding on a horse, more than ten feet away from him. He slapped him in the face in one leap, which was beyond everyone's expectation.Everyone couldn't help but rein in their horses and retreat, looking at each other in astonishment.How can the old man bear this tone if he doesn't guard against being insulted?He immediately dismounted and reached out to grab his clothes.Wen Wenxin hooked his wrist with his backhand.The old man also has martial arts skills. He can use his grasp to transform his palm into a fist, and punch through the bottom of his palm.The two started fighting on the side of the road.
Although Wen Wenxin was beaten by Min Jiageng, his muscles and bones were not injured. Firstly, the person he liked was watching the fight, and secondly, he was too angry to stretch out, so he used Baguazhang more and more cruelly.The old man couldn't catch the move and was hit twice on the shoulder, staggering back a few steps.He must have been excited to come up again, and immediately someone shouted: "Mr. He, please step back, this kid is a bit evil."
As soon as he finished speaking, a figure jumped down from the horse.The old man got out of the way immediately.Wen Wenxin and Yue Qing couldn't help but pay attention when they saw this man's skill.But I saw that he had a purple face, a powerful expression, and a tall body. He stood more than half a head taller than Wen Wenxin.He put his hands behind his back, looked at Wen Wenxin, and asked: "Are you a descendant of Wanlan? Is your master's surname Wen or Wang?" He looked arrogant, not taking the other person seriously at all.
Wen Wenxin was furious and shouted: "Can you take care of it?" The man smiled slightly and said, "As long as the descendants of Wanlan are the descendants of Wan Lan, we can take care of it." Wen Wenxin was originally a delicate person, but this time he suffered repeated setbacks. In his rage, he did not think carefully about the meaning of his words, and struck him on the knee with a "Thunder Strike" move, which was very fast.
The man smiled slightly, waved his right hand lightly, took a step to the left, and immediately resolved the blow.Once Wen Wenxin's Youshen Bagua Palm is used, he does not stop. Every step he takes follows the pattern of the innate Bagua. The turns are as desired, the four tips are unified, and he runs quickly around the opponent's body. The palms are struck faster and faster.The big man made very short moves with his hands. He only showed moves and never touched Wen Wenxin's palm. However, every move he made was the nemesis of Wen Wenxin's palm technique, which often forced him to close his palms and change his posture before he could fully use the move.In an instant, Wen Wenxin struck more than forty palms, but none of them touched the corner of his clothes.The people who came with the big man were delighted and couldn't stop cheering.
Wen Wenxin became anxious, ran faster, and tightened his palm skills.The big man was still taking time off, with a smile on his face, waving or pressing his palms, as if he was practicing boxing alone.At this time, Wen Wenxin could already see that although the opponent's move was very short, his feet followed the innate Bagua pattern, and his position was not messy at all.He once heard his mother say that there is an extremely profound inner Bagua Kung Fu in Baguazhang. Only after you have mastered the outer Bagua Kung Fu to its peak can you start to learn it. But once you master it, you can use your stillness to stop and defeat the enemy's advance, and you will be almost invincible in the world.The person in front of him was clearly giving way to him. As long as he really made a move, he could knock him down in one move.The more he thought about it, the more frightened he became. He jumped back, bowed and clasped his fists and said, "This junior is too blind to see the mountains. It turns out that the seniors of our sect have arrived!" He bowed deeply.
The man smiled slightly and still asked: "Is your master's surname surnamed Wen or Wang?" Wen Wenxin had been told by his mother not to reveal his identity in front of others, in case his enemies knew about it, which would set back his revenge, so he hesitated to answer.The man smiled and said, "You have a wide range of skills. It seems that you belong to the school of Senior Brother Hongwei. Brother, don't you think so?" The last words were addressed to another strong man on the horse.The strong man, who was nearly fifty years old, got off his horse and said to Wen Wenxin: "Where is your master? Lead us to meet him. I am your uncle Li, and this is my brother. You can become your uncle." He laughed loudly.
Wen Wenxin knew that his father Wen Hongwei's master was Li Shiyu, the boss of Wanlan Group.Mr. Li was proficient in Baguazhang and Bagua Dao, and later he created his own Mighty Penetrating Fist, Glory Claws, and Domineering Steel Wrist. At that time, he was so majestic that he was known as "horses treading on both sides of the Yellow River, punching the north and south." The man in front of him was surnamed Li, and he was also a master of Baguazhang. It was definitely true.But he was of a delicate nature, so he asked, "How do you and Wan Lanli always call each other?" The two men looked at each other and smiled, and the strong man said, "That is our brothers' ancestor. Don't you believe it yet? Where is Senior Brother Wen?"
Without hesitation, Wen Wenxin threw himself on the ground, kowtowed a few times, called his uncle, and said, "My late father has passed away a long time ago. Didn't my uncle receive the obituary?"
The elder's name was Li Hongsheng, and his brother's name was Li Hongming. They were both sons of Li Shiyu.After Li Shiyu suffered a setback at the hands of the Cooperation Society, he returned home and took over the Wanlan Logistics Group. From then on, he closed his doors and thanked customers. He died the next year.Wen Hongwei was his first disciple, but the friendship between master and apprentice was ordinary. He left Shanghai early after completing his studies and did not work in Wanlan Group.After the Wanlan Group stopped taking over, the Li brothers entered official careers and were proud of themselves. They never cared about their senior brother in Tiaye.Therefore, although the two parties were not far apart, the Li brothers did not know the news of Wen Hongwei's death.
Li Hongsheng sighed, turned around and whispered a few words to the rich gentleman.The rich gentleman glanced sideways at Yue Qing from the corner of his eyes and nodded happily.Li Hongsheng said to Wen Wenxin, "You live not far from here, right? You take my brother to pay homage to your father's soul. We have been separated for more than twenty years, and we never thought we would never see each other again." He paused, stretched out his hand to the wealthy gentry, and introduced: "You come to see Mr. Wu, we are all working under Mr. Wu."
When Wen Wenxin saw that the rich gentry had a noble bearing and thought he was a high-ranking official in the country, he accepted experts like the Li brothers to work for him. He immediately stepped forward and bowed down.Mr. Wu only waved his hand and said, "Please get up!" but did not return the greeting.Wen Wenxin was slightly angry and thought to himself: "What a big air!"
